title: PerceptionBench tests what multimodal models actually see
friendlyTitle: A new test checks what image AI can really see
summary: Kimi’s PerceptionBench evaluates multimodal language models through atomic visual capabilities identified from model failures. Its goal is to separate basic perception—what a model can actually see—from conclusions it may infer using language and prior knowledge.
friendlySummary: PerceptionBench breaks visual understanding into small skills. It checks whether an AI sees details instead of only making a good guess.
whyItMatters: A model that gives a plausible image answer may still have missed a small but important visual detail. Teams using vision models for documents, quality checks or interfaces need tests that expose perception failures rather than rewarding convincing guesses.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can help teams choose safer image models for documents, inspections and computer screens where small details matter.
